places.name: Lamu Old Town (UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: A historic Swahili settlement and UNESCO World Heritage Site, showcasing traditional architecture and vibrant culture.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored with a local guide.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking through narrow streets.

places.name: Lamu Museum & Swahili House
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing the rich Swahili heritage and traditional coastal lifestyles of Lamu.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Swahili House for a glimpse into traditional living.

places.ai_summary: A historic fort built in the 19th century, now serving as a cultural and community center.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available upon request.

places.place_tip: Climb to the top for panoramic views of the town.

places.ai_summary: A sanctuary dedicated to the rescue and rehabilitation of donkeys, offering a unique interaction experience.

opening_hours.notes: Donations appreciated for the care of the animals.

places.place_tip: Bring carrots or apples to feed the donkeys.

places.ai_summary: A picturesque village with stunning dunes, offering a glimpse into the local way of life and beautiful landscapes.

opening_hours.notes: Respect the local customs and dress modestly.

places.place_tip: Take a guided walk to learn about the flora and fauna.

places.ai_summary: A beautiful, unspoiled beach with endless white sands, perfect for relaxation and water activities.

opening_hours.notes: Bring your own supplies as there are no facilities.

places.place_tip: Check the tide times for the best beach experience.

places.name: Manda Island & Manda Bay
places.ai_summary: An island and bay area known for their stunning natural beauty, rich marine life, and archaeological sites.

opening_hours.notes: Access by boat only; private and shared boats available.

places.place_tip: Bring snorkeling gear to explore the marine life.

places.name: Takwa Ruins (Manda)
places.ai_summary: The ruins of a 15th-century Swahili town, offering a glimpse into the region's historical architecture and layout.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours recommended for better understanding.

places.place_tip: Wear a hat and sunscreen; it can get very hot.

places.name: Kiwayu Marine National Reserve
places.ai_summary: A protected marine area known for its coral reefs, mangroves, and diverse marine species.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited with a guide; snorkeling and diving gear recommended.

places.place_tip: Respect the marine life; do not touch or step on coral reefs.

places.name: Dhow Sailing at Sunset
places.ai_summary: Experience the magic of Lamu's coastline aboard a traditional dhow, with stunning sunset views.

opening_hours.notes: Book in advance, especially during peak season.

places.place_tip: Bring a light jacket; it can get cool on the water.

places.name: Riyadha Mosque & Maulidi Festival
places.ai_summary: A significant mosque in Lamu, known for its unique architecture and the annual Maulidi Festival celebrating the Prophet's birthday.

opening_hours.notes: Respect the prayer times; non-Muslims may not be allowed during prayers.

places.place_tip: Visit during the Maulidi Festival for a unique cultural experience.

places.ai_summary: Traditional dhow-building yards where you can see craftsmen at work and learn about the art of dhow sailing.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning when the craftsmen are most active.

places.place_tip: Ask questions and take photos; the craftsmen are usually very welcoming.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed on a walking tour of Lamu Old Town.

places.place_tip: Look for the 'Lamu Smile' door carvings, a local signature.

places.ai_summary: Kayak through the serene mangrove creeks of Lamu, a great way to explore the coastal ecosystem and spot wildlife.

opening_hours.notes: Best experienced with a guide; wear a life jacket.

places.place_tip: Keep noise to a minimum to avoid scaring wildlife.

places.name: Kipungani Channel Sandbars
places.ai_summary: Visit the stunning sandbars of Kipungani Channel, a perfect spot for swimming, sunbathing, and picnicking.

opening_hours.notes: Access by boat only; bring your own food and drinks.

places.place_tip: Wear reef-safe sunscreen and bring a hat.

places.name: Kizingitini Fishing Village
places.ai_summary: A traditional fishing village where you can experience the local way of life and enjoy fresh seafood.

opening_hours.notes: Respect the local customs and fishing practices.

places.place_tip: Try the fresh seafood at local eateries.

places.name: Peponi Terrace Sea Views
places.ai_summary: A scenic viewpoint offering breathtaking views of the sea and surrounding islands, ideal for photography and relaxation.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset for stunning views.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera and a light jacket for the breeze.

opening_hours.notes: Best done in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring a bag for collecting shells and wear water shoes.

places.place_tip: Stop by the local cafes for a refreshing drink.

places.place_tip: Visit a local guide for a stargazing tour for enhanced experience.
